change.title: Reconcile source-closure metadata, documentation, and compatibility claims

Product runtime behavior and downstream evidence are unchanged.

the installed-provider fixture routes fake sidecar termination through a bounded mock and asserts the exact fake PID and signal instead of signaling the host process table

the frozen f7594c61f9922f3430675f36abfadea9b3a3fda0 predecessor has a PASS exact-SHA fifteen-suite GATE-SOURCE completion seal from run a5ab0c9f478a4fa1fad19036660be2a8, but its clean-context completion review was FAIL
the current reviewer-repair candidate has NOT-RUN exact-SHA GATE-SOURCE and NOT-RUN fresh clean-context completion review, so this record remains NOT-RUN and does not claim SOURCE-GREEN
